results.title: Indian Railways boosts passenger and freight capacity in Maharashtra, Telangana
results.description: In a bid to augment railway capacity and improving train operations, Indian Railways on Friday said it has approved the doubling of the Chouk-Karjat railway section (10.86 km) of Central Railway at a cost of Rs 497 crore.
